gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-khula: Khula reads modern and tall in the middle, its curves holding their mouths open. Neuropolitical, meanwhile, is the one with diagonals as heavy as its verticals, glowing like tube lettering, while Khula is the quieter sans-serif.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-krub: Krub has a pronounced x-height and curves that lift off before the loop closes. Neuropolitical adds the steady pen pressure of neon tubing, and that unbroken line from first letter to last is the strongest thing here.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-kufam: Neuropolitical pulls its words apart letter by letter, every stroke a glowing tube of one width. But Kufam is the plain sans that keeps the line dominated by its bodies, with ascenders barely showing.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-lexend: Lexend reads approachable, its lowercase oversized and every curve left with an open jaw. And Neuropolitical does the showing off, stretching neon-tube letters apart, while Lexend simply keeps the sentences moving.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-lexend-deca: Approachable and unshaded, Lexend Deca never lets a stroke swell. Neuropolitical's glowing, pulled-apart tubes give the pair its strongest quality: a loud heading sitting over a body with small capitals and big lowercase.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-liter: Liter reads modern, with no stroke contrast and a lowercase that stands tall. Neuropolitical stretches neon-tube letters wide across the top, and Liter's wide-mouthed round forms sit underneath as the sans that just gets on with it.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-mada: Mada keeps its curves from closing and towers through the middle of every word. And Neuropolitical's wire-like, spaced-out letters feel almost electric beside it, with Mada the approachable one.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-martel-sans: Neutral and modern, Martel Sans opens every curve and holds a high mean line. Neuropolitical's wirelike strokes of one thickness hum above it, a glowing, spaced-out heading over a plain sans that stays out of the way.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-matangi: Neuropolitical spaces its neon-tube letters apart, each with big open counters, over a body of strokes like twine. Matangi's hefty lowercase makes the plain sans feel solid against that glow.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro reads modern and welcoming, with an open gap in the c and a high-waisted lowercase. And Neuropolitical earns its keep big and short, its neon-tube letters pulled apart one by one.
